why_datasets.klass: Bydelsinndeling is already in the registry with a working Klass GET. Milestone 9 joined it to SSB 11763 on exact bydel_code.
why_datasets.ssb_11763: Table 11763 is a public no-auth SSB PxWeb befolkning/bydel table. Its Region codes 030101-030117 and 030199 are the same strings Klass 1168 stores. 07459 and 11763 are both absent from stored access_path values.
why_datasets.not_m7_m8: OK-BEF008 is Oslo city totals with no bydel or kommune code. Klass 1168 is classification names keyed by 0301xx. Those two do not share a key to a metric.
why_datasets.not_07459: 07459 is live at data.ssb.no/api/v0/no/table/07459 and has kommune 0301, but it is still not an access_path in the registry and it has no bydel codes. Joining one Oslo total onto 42 bydels is the same glue the milestone forbids.
why_datasets.methods: PR 13 is on main. YoY is methods.derive.derive_yoy. This slice calls that function and does not reimplement the rate.
